## Introduction

React icons components for agentscope design icons based on ant design icons

## Install

```bash
yarn add @agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd
```

## Basic Usage

You can import it directly or destructure from `@agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd` when tree-shaking enabled.

```ts
import SmileOutlined from '@agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd/SmileOutlined';
import { SmileOutlined } from '@agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd';

import SmileFilled from '@agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd/SmileFilled';
import SmileTwoTone from '@agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd/SmileTwoTone';
import { SmileFilled, SmileTwoTone } from '@agentscope-ai/icons-override-antd';
```

## Component Interface

```ts
interface AntdIconProps {
  className?: string;
  onClick?: React.MouseEventHandler<SVGSVGElement>;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}
```

## Release

```bash
npm run generate
npm run compile
npm publish
```

## Beware
Must use tnpm i --legacy-peer-deps to install node_modules
